sections.title: Raw source
items: Summary: A one-die roll when the GM leaves an outcome entirely to chance.
When: Use when the PCs are not directly causing the result but chance should decide a detail.
Not When: Do not use it to dodge a player-facing action roll or hide stakes.
Question: Can we just see what chance says?
Answer: Name the stakes first, then roll one Duality Die and interpret it openly.
Example: Roll a Fear Die to set how soon off-screen reinforcements arrive.
Aliases: fate roll chance roll luck roll
Source: Official SRD / local quickstart reference. Use private full-rulebook material only at the table.
